title: 第20章 进化白光
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
金教习举手一按。

    底下残余的躁动完全平息。

    他并没有急着往下说，而是目光缓缓扫过一屋子的年轻人。

    这才开口：

    “御兽进化。靠的是什么？”

    他说话的声音并不大，但是每一个字都非常的清楚。

    话音刚落，他肩膀上那【百问鹦】忽然振翅。

    那一对斑斓的羽翼舒展开来，一道清越的鸟鸣陡然拔高。

    把金教习的一句短短的话，原封不动地送到了这偌大学堂的每一个角落。

    “靠的是什么？”

    【百问鹦】尾音，在房梁上打了个转。

    底下不少崽子，都下意识地坐直了身子。

    “两样。”

    金教习竖起两根手指：

    “一是体质。二是，它体内积蓄的能量达标。”

    他顿了顿。

    “就拿你们家里头，那些最寻常不过的脱凡级御兽来说。

    【黑水牛】、【拉车牛】、【啄虫鸡】，这一类。”

    “只消把觉醒等级，堆到四级，体内能量自然就满了，大多便能水到渠成地自行进化。”

    “这些，蒙学里都教烂了，我不再多费口舌。”

    金教习话锋一转。

    “那我问你们。”

    他身侧的百问鹦，极有默契地，又是一声清鸣。

    “御兽，如何提升它的觉醒等级？”

    这个问题一出，底下呼啦啦，举起了一大片手。

    这是基础里的基础，但凡用心听过蒙学的，都答得上来。

    金教习的目光在那片手臂里转了一圈，落在了一个身形单薄的少年身上。

    “你。”

    被点到的，是李子诚。

    李子诚站起身，不慌不忙。

    “回教习。

    首选是提升御兽的身体素质，为它积蓄体内的能量，再便是，勤加磨炼它的本命技能。

    这两样，都有概率，叫它的觉醒等级，往上提一提。”

    金教习微微颔首。

    “不错。坐下。”

    他负手，踱了两步。

    “这便是山野之间，那些个无主的野兽，提升等级的法子了。”

    他的声音平淡了下来。

    “也正因为如此，它们这一辈子，大多就在这一级、二级、三级里头，打着转。”

    “能熬着熬着，真把等级堆上四级、一朝进化的，少之又少。”

    金教习停下脚步。

    “可我们人，不一样。”

    “我们人族，是这天地之间，唯一一个，天生的辅助种族。”

    “等你们过了考核，成了正式弟子，便能学到一门法子。”

    他略一停顿，继续道：

    “【汲灵术】。”

    肩头的百问鹦，清晰地将这三个字，又复诵了一遍。

    “凭着这门术，你们的御兽，每击败一个对手…

    你们便能将那对手身上的力量，汲取过来，灌注给自家的御兽。”

    “一场一场打下来，你那御兽的等级，涨得比山野里的同类，何止快了十倍。”

    金教习扫视一圈。

    “不过，那是后话了。今日，先按下不表。”

    底下，罗影静静地听着，心头，却是悄然一动。

    【汲灵术】。

    击败对手，汲取力量，灌注己身。

    罗影搭在桌沿上的指尖，几不可察地，顿了一顿。

    这……这不就是他前世，那些个御兽对战的游戏里头，自家御兽击败了敌人，所得来的‘经验值’么？

    只是在那一方天地里，这是天经地义、自动入账的东西。

    可到了这一世，它竟成了一门需得人去苦修的、人族独有的‘术’。

    罗影的心头，像是有什么东西，豁然亮了一下。

    难怪。

    难怪人族，会是这天地间，唯一的辅助种族。

    原来，在这一方天地里，真正执掌着御兽成长的那只手……

    从头到尾，都是人。

    一个念头，紧跟着，从他心底冒了出来。

    既然这‘经验值’，到了此世，化作了【汲灵术】。

    那他前世那游戏里头有过的各色道具，会不会在那些更高深的御兽禁术中体现？

    譬如……那一枚抛出去，便能百分百收服任何御兽的‘大师球’。

    在这一世，会不会也化作了一门，能让人无视一切根骨血脉、强行缔结契约的禁术？

    罗影压下心头那点翻涌的思绪。

    这些，都还太远了。

    眼下，他只死死盯着一桩事。

    讲台上。

    金教习重新立定，环视全场。

    “方才说的，是进化的主流法子。”

    “可除了这一条道……”

    他顿了顿，目光沉了沉：

    “御兽进化，还有别的方法。”

    肩上的百问鹦鹉亦重复了这几个字，清越的声音，在整个场地里回荡。

    “谁知道?“

    这一问出口，学堂里霎时静了。

    方才呼喇喇举起的一大片手臂，此刻只剩稀稀拉拉几只。
content_en:
Jin Jiaoxi raised his hand and pressed.
The remaining restlessness below completely subsided.
He did not rush to speak, but slowly glanced at the young people in the room.
Then he spoke:
"The evolution of beast control. What does it rely on?"
He didn't speak loudly, but every word was very clear.
As soon as he finished speaking, the [Hundred Question Parrot] on his shoulder suddenly fluttered its wings.
The pair of colorful wings spread out, and a clear bird song suddenly rose up.
A short sentence from Professor Jin was sent intact to every corner of this university hall.
"On what basis?"
[Hundred Questions Parrot] The last note echoed on the beams of the house.
Many of the boys below subconsciously sat up straight.
"Both."
Professor Jin raised two fingers:
"The first is the physique. The second is that the energy accumulated in its body reaches the standard."
He paused.
"Take the most common extraordinary beasts in your family.
[Black buffalo], [drawing ox], [insect-pecking chicken], this category."
"As long as the awakening level reaches level four, the energy in the body will naturally be full, and most of them can evolve on their own naturally."
"These are all taught in primary school, so I won't waste any more words."
Jin Jiaoxi changed the subject.
"Then let me ask you."
The Baiwen Parrot next to him gave another clear cry in perfect agreement.
"Mastering the beast, how to increase its awakening level?"
As soon as this question came up, people cheered and a lot of hands were raised.
This is the foundation of the basics. Anyone who has listened carefully to Meng Xue can answer it.
Jin Jiaoxi's eyes turned around in the arm and landed on a thin young man.
"you."
The one who was called out was Li Zicheng.
Li Zicheng stood up and took his time.
“Return to teach and learn.
The first priority is to improve the beast's physical fitness and accumulate energy in its body, and the second is to hone its natural skills diligently.
Both of these have a probability, which is called its awakening level. Let’s mention it."
Jin Jiaoxi nodded slightly.
"Good. Sit down."
He put his hands behind his hands and took two steps.
"This is how those ownerless beasts in the mountains and fields can improve their levels."
His voice became even.
"Because of this, most of their lives have been spinning around in this level, level two, and level three."
"There are very few people who can endure it, really reach level four, and evolve once."
Professor Jin stopped.
"But we humans are different."
"Our human race is the only natural auxiliary race in this world."
"When you pass the test and become a formal disciple, you will be able to learn a method."
He paused briefly and continued:
"[Spirit Absorbing Technique]."
The Baiwen Parrot on the shoulder clearly repeated these three words again.
"With this skill, every time your beast control defeats an opponent...
You can then absorb the power from the opponent and infuse it into your own beast."
"After fighting one battle after another, the level of your beast control has increased ten times faster than that of the same kind in the mountains and fields."
Professor Jin glanced around.
"But, that's a story for another day. Today, let's keep it secret for now."
Below, Luo Ying listened quietly, but his heart moved quietly.
[Spirit Drawing Technique].
Defeat the opponent, draw strength, and infuse yourself.
Luo Ying paused almost imperceptibly with his fingertips resting on the edge of the table.
This... isn't this the 'experience value' he gained from defeating the enemy in those beast-controlling games in his previous life?
But in that world, this is a matter of course and automatically entered into accounts.
But in this life, it has become a "skill" unique to the human race that requires people to practice hard.
Something seemed to light up in Luo Ying's heart.
No wonder.
No wonder the human race is the only auxiliary race in this world.
It turns out that in this world, the hand that really controls the growth of beasts...
From beginning to end, they are all human beings.
A thought came out of his heart right after.
Since this 'experience value', in this life, has turned into [Spirit Drawing Technique].
Then will the various props that he had in the game in his previous life be reflected in the more profound forbidden beast control techniques?
For example... if you throw that one, you can 100% conquer any beast-controlling 'Master Ball'.
In this life, will it also become a forbidden technique that allows people to ignore all bones and blood and forcibly conclude a contract?
Luo Ying suppressed the surging thoughts in his heart.
These are still too far away.
Right now, he was only staring at one thing.
On the podium.
Jin Jiaoxi stood still again and looked around the audience.
"What I just said is the mainstream method of evolution."
"But except for this way..."
He paused and his eyes darkened:
"There are other ways to control the evolution of beasts."
The Baiwen Parrot on the shoulder also repeated these words, and Qingyue's voice echoed throughout the venue.
"Who knows?"
As soon as this question came out, the school fell silent.
There were only a few sparse arms left in the mass of arms that had been lifted up just now.
